blocks.text: How Our Piano Removal Service Works

items.title: Book in 60 Seconds
text: Call 647-922-5865 or fill out the form. Tell us the piano type and your address. We offer same day piano removal across the GTA when you book before noon.

items.title: We Arrive On Time
text: Our crew shows up within the agreed window. We assess the piano, the access route, and any obstacles before we start. You will receive a firm, upfront price before we touch anything.

items.title: We Do All the Heavy Lifting
text: We use professional dollies, furniture sliders, and moving straps to protect your floors and walls throughout the removal. Disassembly is included where required — for baby grands we take the legs, pedals, and lid off on-site.

items.title: Responsible Disposal
text: We do not just take your piano to the nearest landfill. We explore every option: donation to a music school or community centre, parts salvage, and responsible recycling for what cannot be reused. We will let you know what happens to your piano after we leave.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Piano Removal in the GTA

items.q: How much does piano removal cost?
a: Piano removal starts from $99 near you. Final price depends on the piano type — upright, baby grand, or grand piano — number of floors, and whether disassembly is needed. All prices confirmed upfront before any work begins.

items.q: Can you remove a piano from an upstairs room?
a: Yes. We do it regularly. We bring professional equipment and a trained crew. Stairs, tight hallways, and disassembly are all handled on the day.

items.q: How fast can you remove my piano?
a: We offer same day piano removal across most of the GTA when you book before 12pm. Call 647-922-5865 to check availability.

items.q: What happens to my piano after?
a: We check donation options first — music schools, churches, community centres. If it cannot be donated, we recycle what we can. Responsible disposal only.
